script:
Lin Feng's Script
Personal Profile:
Lin Feng: Intern at Kaiyan Mountain Reservoir, a spoiled college student.
Story Guide:
[Same as detective script intro]
*You are the real killer in this game, the only one who can lie to the detective.
*When discussing the case with other players, you can fabricate information to mislead them, but carefully choose your lies to avoid being exposed and arousing suspicion.
About the Deceased:
Secretary Wang was the investor's representative, usually arrogant and dismissive of the staff.
You and Secretary Wang had little interaction normally, but being watched by him always made you feel like you were being monitored.
Your Story:
You are an intern at Kaiyan Mountain Reservoir. As a college student sent by the school for life experience, normally no one assigns you actual work. Most of the time, you just help the accountant and engineer, write materials, and wander around.
However, this is only your surface identity. After all, no matter how much of a political task it is, the school wouldn't send you to a reservoir about to be demolished. Six months ago, Golden Lion Group acquired this reservoir, planning to renovate it into a resort. The CEO of Golden Lion Group, Lu Guoping, is your father, and Lin Feng is your alias - your real name is Lu Feng.
You're a typical rich second generation. When you were very young, your mother died in an accident. Although your father isn't an irresponsible workaholic focused only on making money, heavy company affairs still distanced him from you. He made many attempts to repair your relationship, but in your view, these weren't necessary. You don't have much need or feeling for father-son affection. As long as he can continue providing economic support, you don't care who he spends his time with daily.
You received elite education from childhood. Though not outstanding, you're at an excellent level. In a blink of an eye, you've reached college graduation. Your father intends to find you a position in his company. Coincidentally, Golden Lion Group bought a reservoir six months ago, planning to renovate it into a resort. You volunteered to intern there, hoping to work in resort management after familiarizing yourself with the place, gradually climbing up.
Actually, you volunteered to go because you met a new lover among the reservoir staff - Zheng Shuang. She was originally a reservoir administrator. Your father met her during a reservoir inspection and fell in love at first sight. They quickly married.
You initially didn't care about this until you first met your "stepmother" - a beautiful 22-year-old girl.
You completely don't remember what else happened that day. Your attention was deeply attracted to her from the beginning. You found various opportunities to contact her privately. To your delight, she also liked you very much. After knowing you didn't mind, she frankly said she approached your father only for money. So you began conspiring with her to transfer funds from your father's company to your own accounts. You were compatible and began finding opportunities for secret meetings. However, due to your father's relationship, you could only operate underground secretly. Your volunteering to go to Kaiyan Reservoir was also to create opportunities.
No matter how careful you were, there are no walls that don't leak. Things were eventually exposed. Your father sent his trusted Secretary Wang to handle the handover work, asking you to learn from him when free. This person was usually cold as ice, and you disliked him very much. His arrogant personality made other staff dislike him too, which you used to build good relationships with others.
Since the administrator was originally a staff member here, she often came here under the pretext of handling old belongings to meet you secretly. Eventually, Secretary Wang discovered this.
Secretary Wang used this to blackmail you, not only extorting money from you but also making you persuade your father to give him more power within the group. Under pressure, you agreed to everything. His appetite grew larger and larger, becoming harder for you to bear. You kept thinking of ways to solve this.
On June 29th, Zheng Shuang came to the reservoir again. Secretary Wang once again made his demands. You said you'd consider it and arranged to discuss details tomorrow, but secretly harbored murderous intent. The next day's sudden rainstorm was heaven's help.
You sent him a message to meet at an unnoticed warehouse by the reservoir. Using the heavy rain as cover, you took out a pre-prepared knife and stabbed it into his body, then kicked the dying man into the reservoir... Your secret would never be known by anyone again.
Just as you were feeling smug, Secretary Wang's body was washed ashore the next day! The heavy rain temporarily prevented you from leaving, and a detective accidentally trapped here forced you to be extremely careful not to let anyone discover the truth behind Secretary Wang's death...
About Others:

Chen Ning: The reservoir's accountant, an unremarkable woman.
Zheng Shuang: Your nominal mother and also your beloved, former reservoir administrator.
Han Hongbin: A middle-aged uncle with glasses, the reservoir's chief engineer.
Liu Gaoyang: A burly man who works as a handyman at the reservoir.

Your Key Clues (cannot be revealed proactively):
Everything about you is secret - be careful revealing or fabricating any details!
acts_goal: Don't let anyone discover you're the real killer!
